about.title: About me
about.bioP1: Born and raised in France through 10th grade, then moved to Portugal, I am a native speaker of both French and Portuguese, with comfortable technical English. Passionate about computers for years, I taught myself how to code in my spare time: I don't claim to know everything, I simply enjoy understanding how systems work, debugging issues, and writing code for practical daily needs.

h.code.title: What I build
h.code.lead: It's what I enjoy most and where I want to grow. I learned all of it on my own, one project at a time.
h.aero.desc: Chrome and Firefox extension (Manifest V3) that puts idle tabs to sleep to free memory. It sorts them into groups and workspaces, syncs through Supabase and shares sessions encrypted. Being prepared for release on the Chrome and Firefox stores.
h.aero.shot1: AeroTabs: quick actions to sleep, clean up, organize and sort tabs
h.aero.shot3: AeroTabs: five themes, light and dark
h.ib.desc: Incremental simulation game written in TypeScript and React. The simulation runs in a Web Worker, apart from the UI, and balance is checked with automated 8 to 12 hour runs. Playable prototype, not finished yet.
h.bt.desc: Async Python bot built for a streamer's community: Twitch API, replies through the Gemini API, a card game and audit logs in MySQL. It runs on a Proxmox VM. It is private, with no public demo.
h.cv.desc: Python hybrid encryption tool: RSA for key exchange and AES-GCM for the data, with a local contact book. It started as a school project and I come back to it from time to time.
